name: nextflow
description: Build, migrate, test, debug, and run Nextflow pipelines with Nextflow Platform, Wave, and nf-core.

defaultPrompt: Help me build and test a Nextflow pipeline.
Debug my failed Nextflow Platform run.
Run an nf-core analysis on my sequencing data.
interface.longDescription: Develop and troubleshoot Nextflow pipelines, migrate scripts and Snakemake workflows, create containers and schemas, run nf-core analyses, and manage Seqera workflows through the production MCP server.

positive.description: Find a Nextflow Registry module for a task
positive.prompt: Find an nf-core module in the Nextflow registry for trimming adapters from paired-end Illumina reads, and tell me how to include it in my pipeline.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Nextflow Registry, recommends a matching module such as nf-core/trimgalore or nf-core/fastp with a registry link, and shows how to include it as a Nextflow-managed module.

positive.description: Describe a module's inputs and outputs
positive.prompt: What are the inputs and outputs of the nf-core/fastqc module?
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up nf-core/fastqc and lists its input tuple (meta map and reads) and its outputs (HTML report, zip archive, versions) with a short explanation of each.

positive.description: Recommend an nf-core pipeline for an analysis
positive.prompt: Which nf-core pipeline should I use for bulk RNA-seq differential expression, and what does it need as input?
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends nf-core/rnaseq for processing raw reads and nf-core/differentialabundance for the differential expression step, and describes the samplesheet and reference inputs each one needs.

positive.description: Build a samplesheet from public sequencing data
positive.prompt: Find the sequencing runs for GEO study GSE110004 and make me an nf-core/rnaseq samplesheet for them.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the GEO study to its SRA runs, reports how many runs were found and whether they are paired- or single-end, and writes an nf-core/rnaseq samplesheet CSV with sample, fastq_1, fastq_2 and strandedness columns.

positive.description: Check recent runs on Seqera Platform
positive.prompt: Show me my most recent pipeline runs on Seqera Platform and tell me whether any of them failed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the signed-in user's recent workflow runs with pipeline name, submission time and status, links each run in Seqera Platform, and states whether any run failed.

negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be in Barcelona this weekend?
Translate this paragraph into French: "Our team meets every Monday to plan the week ahead."

negative.description: Unrelated request: writing a cover letter
negative.prompt: Write me a cover letter for a marketing manager job.
